integrity: The established orbital time-change to a linear center is attributed to Banaji, Boros and Hofbauer; the newly analyzed claim is global original-physical-time classification, period/occupation/exposure, critical rational pulse and decay rates. Analytic argument plus reproducibility checks; no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Positive A, D>A, C>F>=0 and the special zero-trace locus only; backward x>0 exterior arcs may leave the positive quadrant; no results away from the center locus or for stochastic kinetics.
title: Exact physical-time phase portrait and invariant exposure at a three-reaction chemical center
